About the role The System Architect is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining complex automotive embedded systems and system-of-systems throughout the product lifecycle. The role requires deep understanding of customer use cases, stakeholder needs, system behavior, internal and external interfaces, and functional architectures. The System Architect acts as the technical owner of the system concept and ensures that requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification strategies are complete, consistent, traceable, and aligned with customer expectations and industry standards. Beyond individual contributions, the System Architect provides technical leadership across multiple engineering disciplines, including System, Software, Hardware, Integration, Verification & Validation, Security, and Functional Safety teams. The role drives technical decisions, supports customer discussions, and ensures successful execution of system engineering activities in compliance with ASPICE and Bosch development processes. Main responsibilities 1. System Requirements Engineering Elicit, analyze, negotiate, document, and manage stakeholder requirements. Translate customer and stakeholder needs into clear, complete, and testable system requirements. Ensure consistency, completeness, feasibility, and verifiability of requirements. Define acceptance criteria and verification strategies for system requirements. Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability between stakeholder requirements, system requirements, architecture elements, and verification artifacts. Conduct impact analysis for requirement changes and coordinate implementation across affected domains. Review, approve, baseline, and release system requirements. 2. System Architecture & Design Define and maintain system architecture for complex embedded systems and system-of-systems. Analyze functional, logical, and technical interactions between software, hardware, communication networks, cloud services, mobile applications, and vehicle systems. Identify, specify, and maintain system interfaces and interaction models. Lead architectural trade-off studies considering performance, safety, security, cost, maintainability, and customer expectations. Ensure architectural consistency across all engineering disciplines. Support architectural decomposition into hardware, software, and verification work products. Technical Leadership & Coordination Serve as technical lead for system engineering topics within projects. Coordinate system engineering activities across multiple teams and disciplines. Guide and mentor System Engineers and junior team members. Drive technical alignment between stakeholders, project management, customers, and engineering teams. Facilitate technical reviews, workshops, architecture reviews, and requirement clarification sessions. Lead root-cause analysis and complex debugging activities involving Software, Hardware, V&V, Security, and System Integration teams 3. Verification & Validation Support Define system-level verification approaches and success criteria. Ensure system requirements are fully testable and traceable to verification activities. Support creation and review of test strategies, test specifications, and validation plans. Analyze system verification results and drive corrective actions when deviations occur 4. Process Compliance & Quality Assurance Take ownership of ASPICE SYS.1, SYS.2, SYS.3, and relevant lifecycle work products. Ensure compliance with Bosch development processes, customer-specific processes, and quality standards. Support project assessments, audits, and process improvement initiatives. Drive continuous improvement of system engineering methodologies, templates, and best practices 5. Customer Technical Interface Coordinate team on System Engineering tasks. Lead and participate into debug session with other domains (Software, Test, Hardware, etc Act as a primary technical contact for system-level discussions with customers. Lead requirement clarification and technical alignment meetings. Support effort estimation, risk assessment, and change request evaluations. Present system concepts, technical solutions, and engineering decisions to customers and management. Mandatory Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Science , or a related engineering field. 8+ years of experience in Automotive Embedded Systems Development , including 5+ years in System Engineering . Strong expertise in System Engineering, System-of-Systems Architecture, Requirements Engineering, and System Architecture Design . Solid understanding of the V-Model development lifecycle and experience with ASPICE-compliant development . Strong knowledge and practical experience with AUTOSAR-based systems . Hands-on experience with automotive communication technologies, particularly CAN, UWB, and BLE . Good understanding of embedded software, hardware architecture, microcontrollers, and system integration . Ability to analyze and challenge customer requirements, technical specifications, and industry standards . Proven ability to lead technical discussions and coordinate engineering activities across multiple disciplines . Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Proactive, self-driven, and quality-oriented mindset. Fluent English , both written and spoken. Nice-to-have: Experience with LIN and NFC communication technologies. Experience with Radar systems and Radar measurements. Knowledge of Functional Safety (ISO 26262). Knowledge of Automotive Cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434). Experience with Car Connectivity Consortium (CCC) standards and Digital Key solutions. Experience with system integration and vehicle-level validation. Experience mentoring or leading System Engineering teams.. WHY BOSCH? Because we don't just follow trends, we create them. Because together we turn ideas into reality, working every day to make the world of tomorrow a better place. Do you have high standards when it comes to your job? So do we. At Bosch, you will discover more than just work. Benefits and Career Opportunities Working in one of the Best Places to Work in Vietnam and Top 30 of the Most Innovative Companies all over the world Join a dynamic and fast-growing global company ( English-speaking environment) Engage in our diverse training programs which surely help strengthen both your personal and professionalism 13th-month salary bonus + attractive performance bonus (you'll love it!) + annual performance appraisal 100% monthly salary and mandatory social insurances in 2-month probation Meal, Commuting and Parking allowance Premium health insurance for you and 02 family members 15++ days of annual leave + 1 day of birthday leave Flexible working time Free in-house entertainment facilities and sport activities : football, badminton, yoga, Aerobics….
